facts.fact: Drakken 原本答应训练 Max，却仍在 Greyhold 镇守东部边境、暂无归期，Max 因他不在而心里发闷。
facts.quote: Drakken was supposed to take up my training, as he’d promised, but he was still at Greyhold, holding the eastern border

facts.fact: Caspian 踩着旱冰鞋冲进继承人的私人训练室。
facts.quote: he came through the door on roller blades that rumbled like low thunder

facts.fact: Max 向 Caspian 借一双旱冰鞋，Caspian 蹲下握住她的脚检查尺码。
facts.quote: Caspian dropped down beside me with animal ease and lifted my foot into his hand.

facts.fact: Max 告诉 Caspian：Missy 并非她血亲，Missy 的母亲死于难产、父亲在矿井里出事故后，Missy 才来与她同住，并已为她做了一年情报员。
facts.quote: Missy isn’t my blood. Her mother died in childbirth, and after her father’s accident in the shafts, she came to live with me.

facts.fact: Caspian 向 Max 保证会把 Missy 救回来，态度一改轻松，显出不会食言的分量。
facts.quote: “We’ll get her back,” Caspian said. The easy warmth was gone, replaced by the weight of a man who didn’t break promises.

facts.fact: Max 发现自己正在忘记父母的脸；她知道白女巫处决了 Caspian 的父母，也杀了 Drakken 和 Nikolai 的父母。
facts.quote: I knew the White Witch had executed his parents. The same woman had murdered Drakken’s and Nikolai’s as well.

facts.fact: Caspian 把 Max 摔到垫子上开训，趁他忙着替自己辩护时，Max 用他动怒露出的空隙翻身骑到他身上。
facts.quote: While he was busy defending his good name, fully distracted, I bridged, twisted, and drove my shoulder into the gap his temper had opened.

facts.fact: Nikolai 出现在门口叫停这次训练，说 Haven 那边刚传来情报，伸手要 Max 跟他走；Max 立刻从 Caspian 身上跳下来。
facts.quote: “Session’s over.” Nikolai turned from the wall, the amusement gone, replaced by something more serious. “Intel from the Haven just came in.”

relations: Caspian 是变形者（shifter）王子，与 Max 相处亲近轻松，是四继承人中最会逗她开心的一位
Frost 负责 Max 的训练安排，把她带进继承人的私人训练室后离开
Drakken 是第四位继承人，原答应亲自训练 Max，但仍在 Greyhold 守东线
Nikolai 是吸血鬼王子，与 Caspian 互相敌视；他曾教过 Max 潜行，并且被 Max 认为在散播对她不利的流言
Missy 是 Max 收养的妹妹（非血亲），在 Haven 当“小间谍”为 Max 收集情报，从未被抓
白女巫处决了 Caspian、Drakken、Nikolai 三人的父母
Max 当年为嘲讽 Delia 一党而称 Caspian 是“ten”，此话被阿尔丁诺尔听见，也传到了 Caspian 耳中
numbers: start at a three and work his way up
Three or more people witness something, it leaks
By eleven I was taller than everyone in the mine
